evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: The format check at lines 790-791 only enforces 40 lowercase hex characters and never verifies the object is a commit. In the no-tag path a caller-supplied annotated-tag object ID passes; git peels it for merge-base/ls-tree/show/checkout, so all deployability checks and the detach succeed, but `switch()` and the intent record keep the tag object ID rather than the commit at HEAD, leaving the recorded deployment identity inconsistent with the actual deployed commit. Requiring `git cat-file -t target` to equal `commit` before the ancestry check is the smallest compatible fix; it does not change behavior for the legitimate commit-SHA inputs the function documents, so no owner decision is needed.
